out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observe fruit flies in small area near management office.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit 17-service area: 2dr cooler left door needs repair.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Salad/app prep area: front prep cooler: chicken salad , egg salad, chop hard broil eggs, dice tomatoes, cook cube chicken 44F,44F,50F,54F,50F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All items above were moved to the walk-in cooler.
